delete.description: Sign out everywhere else: every session except this one.

post.description: Always 202: the answer never reveals whether the email belongs to an account.
Sets the new password and ends every session. Does not sign in; MFA is still required.

The emailed link and the password open an enrolment-only session; the new authenticator
is then set up with `/me/mfa/totp/setup` and `/me/mfa/totp/confirm`.

get.description:
Accounts, oldest first. Accounts of people who have been offboarded are listed on the
former employees page instead, unless `include_offboarded` is set or `employee_id` asks
for the account of one record.

post.description: Create an invited account and queue its invite email. Grants no role.

Link an existing account to an employee record. Needs `employee.lifecycle.manage` over
the employee too, step-up and a reason; the account's email must be the work email.

Remove every authenticator and recovery code of another account, sign it out everywhere
and email a re-enrolment link. Step-up; never one's own account.
Send a new invite link; the previous link stops working now.

delete.description: Make the outstanding invite link stop working and cancel an invite not yet sent.

schema.title: Response Assign Role Api V1 Users  User Id  Roles Post

202.description: For `super_admin`: a request that a second super admin must approve.

post.description:
Assign several roles in one transaction with one step-up; all or none. Roles already
held are kept. `super_admin` is refused here (`409 role.super_admin_alone`): it is
assigned on its own, as a request a second super admin approves.
Ask for a role for yourself for a limited time. Another super admin must approve it.
Emergency only: `system_admin` for yourself for at most an hour, without approval.
Withdraw a pending request, or end an active elevation or break-glass now.
Record the post-incident review of a break-glass use (by another super admin).

put.description: `security.*` keys additionally need `security.settings.manage`; both need step-up.

get.description:
People who have been offboarded, at the reader's scope, with their last job and their
account's state (for readers holding `user.read.all`; the `account` filter needs it too).
Erased records are not listed. Read-only.

post.description:
Records a status change. To record someone leaving, use `POST /employees/{id}/exit`,
which also disables their account and revokes their sessions in the same step.

The employee leaves: the record is marked exited from the last working day and their
account is disabled with every session revoked, in one step (needs `user.disable` and a
recent step-up when an account is linked).

get.description:
Personal tier: HR (`employee.personal.read.all`), audited. A manager reaches their team's
contacts only if Sigvitas grants `employee.emergency_contact.read.team`.

post.description:
Records the event at the server's time and returns the updated day. Requires an
`Idempotency-Key`: repeating a request with the same key does not record it twice.

get.description: Where everyone in the viewer's scope stands today, and counts over the whole scope.
Everyone in the viewer's scope employed on the date, with that day judged.

Per person in scope: days per status and the period's totals (RPT-1: only what the
viewer may already read).

post.description: Ask to add or remove events on one of your work dates, with a reason.

HR records a correction on the employee's behalf (ATT-8). It applies at once and the
employee and their manager are told (SOD-7). Never on one's own attendance.

get.description:
Corrections in the viewer's scope, or with `for_decision` those waiting for a decision
the viewer may make. Reasons are never listed.
The correction with the day before and after it, side by side (ATT-7).

post.description:
New times or weekly offs from a date. The current version ends that day; past days keep
the version they were judged with.
The shift everyone at a location works unless they have their own assignment.

Assign a shift from a date to one or more people; each one's current assignment ends
that day.

A new policy version for a scope from a date; the current one of that scope ends then.
Every value is entered here: none is assumed.
Close past dates to corrections, except by HR holding `attendance.correction.approve.all`.

get.description: Who in the viewer's scope has no shift, or no attendance policy, today (ATT-12).
Every version of every office's location check, newest first per office.

post.description:
A new version of an office's check from a date (today or later); it closes the open one.
`mode: off` turns the check off from that date. Audited.

get.description: Offices people may clock at besides their job's location, within the reader's scope.

post.description: Approve an office for a person from a date (today or later). Audited.
End an approval from a date (today or later). Audited.

get.description:
Clock events flagged for location review, newest first, within the reader's scope and
never the reader's own.
One flagged clock event with the day's events and the review history. Audited.

post.description:
Record a decision on a flagged clock event. It never changes the event; a change to the
attendance itself is a correction. A stale `supersedes` is refused (409). Audited.

put.description: The location uses this calendar for its year, replacing the one it used before.

get.description: Holidays of the calendar your current location uses, between two dates.

post.description: A new effective-dated version for a scope; the scope's open version ends the day it starts.
An adjustment or opening balance with a reason. Never on your own balance.

The upfront allocation of one leave year for every employee you may adjust; running it
again allocates only to those not yet allocated for that year.

get.description:
Days taken and pending per person and leave type in the period, for the people the
reader may see (RPT-1). Reasons are never included.

post.description:
Close a leave year for one leave type: carry each balance forward up to the policy's
cap and lapse or keep the rest. With `apply: false` nothing is recorded; each employee is
closed at most once.

Check opening balances row by row; with `apply: true` and every row fine, record them
as one import batch. A file with any refused row records nothing.
How the days count and what the balance would be, without saving anything.
Repeating a request with the same `Idempotency-Key` returns the first result.

Withdraw a pending request, or cancel approved leave that has not started (which goes to
the approver when the leave type needs approval).

get.description:
Requests in your scope, newest first. With `awaiting_my_decision`, the requests you may
decide that are waiting for a decision, oldest first. No reasons.
The reason is shown to the employee and to whoever may decide the request.

post.description: Approve a pending request, or the cancellation asked for on approved leave.

Reject a pending request, or keep approved leave whose cancellation was asked for. A note
is required.

get.description: Who is away in your scope (at most 93 days): leave type and dates, never the reason.

For the header badge. Send `X-SV-Background: 1` when polling, so polling does not keep
an idle session alive.

put.description:
Turn notification types on or off per channel. Security emails are not listed and are
always sent.

post.description: Add a document to your own record, in a category that allows it.

get.description: The employee's documents in the categories the reader may see (DOC-2).

patch.description: Change the title or expiry date, or archive or restore the document (HR).

post.description:
A link to the file valid for 60 seconds, once it passed the virus check. Every
download is audited (DOC-3, DOC-4).
A new version of a document (DOC-6); earlier versions stay available.
Per person: days per status and the period's totals. Needs a recent step-up.
One row per person and day, as judged. Needs a recent step-up.
Leave requests overlapping the period, without reasons. Needs a recent step-up.
Each person's balance per leave type on the day the file is produced.
Employee records (job details and dates; no personal details).
The audit log recorded in the period. Needs a recent step-up.

get.description: Exports you asked for, newest first.

post.description: A 60-second link to an export you asked for, until it expires. Audited.

get.description: Erasure requests, newest first.

post.description:
Ask for the permanent erasure of an offboarded person's data. Step-up. A different super
admin must approve it; nothing is erased until then.

Approve and run another super admin's request: the records are erased in one transaction
and the stored files are removed by the worker. Step-up; the employee code typed again.
The requester withdraws a request still waiting.

AssignmentBatchCreate.title: AssignmentBatchCreate
AssignmentBatchCreate.description: Several roles for one account, with one reason; all are assigned or none.

CapturedLocation.title: CapturedLocation
CapturedLocation.description:
A position the browser reported for this press (ADR-031). Used to judge the event and
then discarded: it is never stored, logged or returned.

CurrentElevation.title: CurrentElevation
CurrentElevation.description: The elevation or break-glass that applies to the signed-in account now, if any.

DeviceView.title: DeviceView
DeviceView.description: A browser the account has signed in from. Recognizing it never skips MFA or step-up.

EmployeeLinkRequest.title: EmployeeLinkRequest
EmployeeLinkRequest.description:
Link an existing account to an employee record. The reason is recorded in the audit
log: say why the account was not linked at invite (for example, invited before the record
existed), not personal details.

EmployeeStatistics.title: EmployeeStatistics
EmployeeStatistics.description:
Counts over the employees the actor may read (docs/product-requirements.md EMP-7):
`employed` is the `current` employment of the employee list today; `active` and `on_notice`
split it by recorded status; `future_joiners` and `former` match `future` and `former`.
`pre_joining` counts the recorded status, whatever the dates. Headcounts and recent joiners
count `current` employees only.

EmployeeUpdate.title: EmployeeUpdate
EmployeeUpdate.description: HR edits of profile fields. Job, status and joining date change through their own routes.

EventLocationView.title: EventLocationView
EventLocationView.description: The location check of one clock event: the outcome only, never a distance.

FailedLocation.title: FailedLocation
FailedLocation.description: Why no position was reported for this press.

Headcount.title: Headcount
Headcount.description: Employees employed today whose current job is in one department, designation or location.

HolidayUpdate.title: HolidayUpdate
HolidayUpdate.description: The name, or whether a holiday is optional. The date and the kind do not change.

InviteActivated.title: InviteActivated
InviteActivated.description: The account is active and signed in. The recovery codes are shown only here.

InviteEnrolment.title: InviteEnrolment
InviteEnrolment.description: Binds steps 2 and 3 to the browser that set the password. Valid for 30 minutes.

LeaveCalendarEntry.title: LeaveCalendarEntry
LeaveCalendarEntry.description: Who is away: no reason, ever (product-requirements LV-8).

LeavePolicyCreate.title: LeavePolicyCreate
LeavePolicyCreate.description:
A new version for a scope (leave type, plus an optional location and employment type).
The scope's open version, if it starts earlier, ends the day this one starts.

LeaveTypeCreate.title: LeaveTypeCreate
LeaveTypeCreate.description: Every rule is stated explicitly: nothing is assumed for Sigvitas.

LoginChallenge.title: LoginChallenge
LoginChallenge.description: Proof that the password step passed. Single-use, valid for 5 minutes.

MfaResetRequest.title: MfaResetRequest
MfaResetRequest.description:
Why the reset is needed, recorded in the audit log. Record the identity check that was
done (docs/runbooks), not personal details.

RecoveryCodes.title: RecoveryCodes
RecoveryCodes.description: Shown once. Each code works once; the previous unused codes stop working.

RequestSummary.title: RequestSummary
RequestSummary.description: For lists and inboxes: no reason.

SignedIn.title: SignedIn
SignedIn.description: Session cookies are set. `mfa_enrolment` allows only setting up a new authenticator.

qr_code.title: Qr Code
qr_code.description: SVG QR code of otpauth_uri as a data: URI, for an element

TotpSetup.title: TotpSetup
TotpSetup.description: Shown once. The secret is never returned again.
